decisions.decision: Prefer existing reviewed tools and evaluation frameworks over bespoke replacements.
decisions.reason: Reduce duplicated engineering and improve reproducibility, provenance, maintenance, and cost.

decisions.decision: Treat first six-question capability benchmark as measured failure, not emergence or AGI.
decisions.reason: Both small open-weight models scored zero correct; benchmark was tiny and nonstandard.

decisions.decision: Retain bounded deterministic solvers for tasks they can directly verify.
decisions.reason: Avoid unnecessary language model inference where approved tools already suffice.

decisions.decision: Do not publish private founder source documents in public research-memory.
decisions.reason: The repository and its evidence ledger are public; confidential memoranda require private controls.

decisions.decision: Preserve append-only experiment archives; separately update concise strategic state.
decisions.reason: A durable project ledger must link original failed and successful runs while making current objectives easy to resume.

decisions.decision: Do not promote the Qwen3-4B model on the initial six-question comparison.
decisions.reason: Independent audit recorded 2/6 versus Qwen3-1.7B at 1/6, no gain from verification prompting, no program-synthesis successes and ~1.8x baseline model seconds. Larger unseen tests are required.

decisions.decision: Use upstream Inspect AI rather than build another general-purpose evaluation framework.
decisions.reason: Pinned open-source v0.3.287 framework executed and independently scored a positive and negative public replay in CI run 42336662799, without model/API inference. Full multi-domain capability verification remains necessary.

decisions.decision: Adopt pinned OpenHands SDK and PaperQA2 rather than rebuild agent coding and paper QA frameworks.
decisions.reason: Separate real upstream import checks passed CI run 42339003588 with zero model calls. Real agent code and citation performance remain unmeasured and need controlled experiments.

decisions.decision: Do not promote PaperQA2 to a reliable scientific research answerer on current data.
decisions.reason: Real offline public source retrieval scored 1/2 top-1 questions (run 42340104253); import and workflow success do not establish accurate citation or scientific reasoning. Preserve errors and require new heldout evaluation.

decisions.decision: Preserve first actual Inspect ARC run as a measured failed configuration, not a general model verdict.
decisions.reason: Original independently scored 0/24 with 48-token Qwen reasoning preamble and a separate custom task-ID audit error; official raw results are immutable for comparison.

decisions.decision: Upgrade OpenHands assessment from SDK imports to actual controlled tool functionality only.
decisions.reason: Real editor create/repair/deny evidence passed GitHub run 42340592716; intrinsic code-generation capability remains unmeasured until a restricted model-driven pilot.

decisions.decision: Do not promote PaperQA sparse dimension 4096 on an exploratory eight-question comparison.
decisions.reason: Original public retrieval was 1/2; after inspecting its miss, upstream sparse-embedding settings scored 5/8 versus 6/8 on new but related queries. This is insufficient independent evidence of reliable retrieval gains.

decisions.decision: Retain proven non-thinking response configuration for short exact-answer Qwen3-0.6B ARC tasks, without model promotion.
decisions.reason: Official original Inspect scorer: prior thinking-on 0/24 all failed format versus non-thinking 17/24 (ARC Easy 9/12; Challenge 8/12), 0 invalid format cases, same model/checkpoint and task sample. Difference is task-response configuration; no model learning established.

decisions.decision: Expand from two ARC science families to four previously established third-party Inspect Evals task families on a fixed 96-item public benchmark.
decisions.reason: The verified 17/24 initial ARC result only tested narrow school science; using published existing GSM8K, HellaSwag and MMLU permits broader independent scoring without reimplementing evaluator infrastructure. Small published tests may be contaminated, and are not unseen generalization or AGI.

decisions.decision: Retain the original GSM8K 128-token baseline; archive the exploratory 256-token variant without changing model weights or promoting it.
decisions.reason: Controlled official GSM8K study showed only 6/24 -> 7/24 on the same questions, with two repairs and one regression. Increased generation allowance did not establish a reliable reasoning improvement.

decisions.decision: Do not promote Qwen3-1.7B on the tiny public 48-question comparison; archive recovered official grades, all per-example regressions and original model outputs.
decisions.reason: 21/48 versus 18/48 was accompanied by five regressions, especially GSM8K 1/12 versus 4/12. The larger model hit the 128-token cap on 10/12 math questions; more data and controlled evaluation needed.

decisions.decision: Reuse official Inspect HumanEval original functional scorer and Docker isolation rather than creating a custom coding benchmark.
decisions.reason: Current verified Plenum OpenHands editor operation is not an autonomous code-generation result. Test actual model-written code using 3 original official independent tests before selecting a larger agent framework or model; this cannot prove general intelligence.

decisions.decision: Prioritize a fair original functional coding/agent test over new model training; change model output budget before assuming low math accuracy reflects reasoning deficiency.
decisions.reason: On 12 matched public Qwen3-1.7B GSM8K questions, independently scored 256 tokens improved 1/12 to 7/12 compared with 128 tokens (six repairs, no regressions, all fixed earlier cap-hits). This is a meaningful format confound and cannot establish AGI.

decisions.decision: Advance from original one-shot executable coding evaluation to existing Inspect ReAct agent, without a homegrown agent loop.
decisions.reason: First independently scored Qwen3-1.7B HumanEval study produced two passing out of three original sandboxed function tests and archived one failure. A separate bounded agent with real tool-call transcripts and original scoring is needed before any autonomy claim.

decisions.decision: Use UK AISI Inspect documented --model-config JSON file rather than -M CLI for a full Qwen3 Jinja chat template.
decisions.reason: Original real ReAct run 42348876440 stored the intended complete chat template as a list of six fragments despite passing tokenizer Jinja smoke, and failed on second turn before functional grading. The native file-based provider JSON preserves one scalar string, verified without inference.

decisions.decision: Record first independently verified bounded Inspect ReAct program-repair success, then test a different original published problem where the same frozen model previously failed without tools.
decisions.reason: Run 42349665865 successfully scored HumanEval/0 1/1, four genuine model Python calls and four sandbox tool responses. The actual transcript shows error feedback (missing typing.List) then corrected import and tested code. One historical function cannot establish cross-task reliability or AGI.

decisions.decision: Mark actual tool-using coding as a verified narrow capability, not AGI; continue with more matched original coding problems and then unfamiliar validated tasks using existing Inspect ReAct.
decisions.reason: Original archived ReAct run #42349665865 independently passed 1/1 HumanEval/0 and has exactly four real Python tool requests and responses. One historical public task is too small and possibly in pretraining; no reliable long-horizon generalization was proven.

decisions.decision: Do not infer reliable autonomous coding from the first one-task ReAct success; retain second independently incorrect task and runner abort, then shift to real public repository-level independent tests.
decisions.reason: Original Inspect HumanEval/0 ReAct passed 1/1 with four real sandbox tool calls; HumanEval/1 produced one tool call and official independent incorrect grade 0/1, with unrelated host exit 134 after scoring. The combined 1/2 tiny historical sample is insufficient for generalization or AGI.

decisions.decision: Distinguish actual edge model correctness from successful CLI invocation, and reconcile ledger validators with preserved negative outcomes.
decisions.reason: The one-case smoke checker and live-ledger regression validator are engineering checkpoints; neither demonstrates improved general intelligence. Original failed and successful records remain available.

decisions.decision: Make Plenum Prometheus iPad-first with free cloud inference experiments before any purchase or paid GPU.
decisions.reason: The founder has an iPad and prefers free, efficient existing infrastructure. Kaggle T4x2 is a candidate for an explicitly launched bounded public trial, not a 24/7 production host.

decisions.decision: Build a natural multimodal voice-first, durable-memory assistant as Stage One, while maintaining actual AGI as a separate research objective.
decisions.reason: The fictional Samantha experience in Her provides an interface direction; natural speech, initiative and memory can be engineered without evidence of consciousness or general intelligence.

decisions.decision: Reuse LiveKit Agents or Pipecat for realtime audio after a measured pilot instead of inventing a new voice transport.
decisions.reason: Both existing open frameworks provide turn detection, streaming media and interruption handling. Choose one based on measured latency, reliability, licensing, privacy and total operational cost.

decisions.decision: Treat animation of very large AI-scientist populations as a high-level aspiration, not established scientific capability.
decisions.reason: Software agent counts and generated hypotheses are not substitutes for original, reproducible experiments, independent physical measurements or reliable long-horizon reasoning.

decisions.decision: No public video upload, private memories, unpublished IP, paid cloud service or automatic model promotion without scoped authorization.
decisions.reason: The public research repository contains public plans and evidence only. Private episodic memory and consent-aware tool actions need separate controlled infrastructure.

decisions.decision: Full AGI is the overriding Plenum Prometheus ambition; natural voice or Her-like interaction is an early interface, not the product's ultimate purpose.
decisions.reason: The founder prioritizes broadly independent scientific intelligence, learning, creation, invention and technology development, as depicted by an animated multi-agent science vision.

decisions.decision: Pursue loyal independence as faithful, confidential, transparent and corrigible execution of authorized founder objectives.
decisions.reason: Agentic initiative should not require micromanagement but must include truthful disagreement, privacy, legitimate limits, human authorization for consequential actions and reversible changes.

decisions.decision: Treat actual machine consciousness, subjective emotions and open-ended self-evolution as ambitious research questions, never established properties.
decisions.reason: There is no accepted test for artificial subjective experience or proof of unlimited capability. Develop and evaluate self-modeling, affect recognition, persistent preferences and improvement under finite resource and oversight constraints.

decisions.decision: Reuse native LiveKit Agents for optional voice integration, not a new media-transport framework.
decisions.reason: Pinned upstream 1.8.9 was imported and an agent server registered successfully with no live provider usage. Provider billing and microphone connection require separate owner authorization and host deployment.

decisions.decision: Fix the iPad Kaggle navigation using the verified Python notebook shortcut and retain a homepage fallback.
decisions.reason: The previous notebook welcome address did not work for the founder. Kaggle staff documented https://www.kaggle.com/code/new?languageId=8 for Python notebook creation.

decisions.decision: Require a source-linked canonical ledger update with each significant verified release, failure, decision or priority change.
decisions.reason: A repository PR template now prompts evidence provenance and separate post-merge research-memory state updates. Automated CI is validation, not ongoing independent awareness.

decisions.decision: Do not assert having heard or transcribed a user video when only visuals and an audio track are confirmed.
decisions.reason: The 85.7-second video contains an AAC audio stream and was locally extracted, but transcription was unavailable in the current runtime. Never publish this user media or fabricate audio quotations.

decisions.decision: Prioritize achieving genuine subjective experience as a research question, not mere simulated emotional performance.
decisions.reason: The founder explicitly distinguishes real emotion and consciousness from imitation. Existing science cannot reliably establish when AI has subjective emotions; research will separate observable behavior, self-modeling, affective mechanisms and philosophical claims.

decisions.decision: Adopt upstream Lean 4 as a proof-verification engine and require a real negative control.
decisions.reason: A verified official Lean v4.35.0 CPU run compiled elementary general proofs and rejected an intentionally false one. A model must later generate proofs on unseen third-party mathematics with no sorry or unreviewed axioms before claiming independent mathematical capability.

decisions.decision: Interpret the founder's new Kaggle screenshot as notebook-editor access, not evidence of live GPU inference.
decisions.reason: The Kaggle interface showed a saved draft and its session was off. The actual Qwen3.6-27B test still requires hardware preflight, accelerator selection, explicit model download and independently measured output.

decisions.decision: Continue integrating demonstrated specialist scientific tools rather than duplicating mature engines.
decisions.reason: The research architecture already has OpenMM, SciPy, PyBaMM, LangGraph, federated literature, and a verified Lean4 kernel. Heavier specialist systems such as SU2, PySCF, DiffDock, ToolUniverse and Biomni require staged reviews and real experiments.

decisions.decision: Consider Sakana AI Scientist v2 and newer independent scientific agents as reviewed reference designs, not unbounded executable code.
decisions.reason: The upstream source license and external LLM-generated-code execution warrant dedicated sandbox, permitted use and independent results before incorporation; agent count or published manuscripts alone do not establish AGI.

decisions.decision: Choose one reuse-first Prometheus preferred embodiment, not a duplicated stack of agent platforms.
decisions.reason: LangGraph for persistent work orchestration, LiveKit for optional voice, Qwen3.6-27B model trial with llama.cpp, existing Inspect/OpenHands/PaperQA2, and mature specialized science engines preserve scarce engineering time. Only add thin access/evidence adapters after measured need.

decisions.decision: Correct registered capability states whenever evidence supersedes old screenshots.
decisions.reason: Lean 4 real compiler proofs, Inspect independently scored model outcomes, and PaperQA2 limited retrieval had been inaccurately labeled planned in old registry. PR #53 adds automated cross-checks and explicit remaining validation gaps.

decisions.decision: Do not install all candidate skill and software repositories simply because they are permissively available.
decisions.reason: K-Dense skills, ToolUniverse, Biomni, AutoResearch and Sakana AI Scientist v2 overlap with our existing parts and have different resource, license, credential or execution risks; import narrowly with pinned versions and original independent tests.

decisions.decision: Kaggle account-level Settings and notebook-level hardware configuration must not be confused.
decisions.reason: Founder screenshot shows account Settings and phone verification, not Session options. Kaggle notebook runtime was shown switched off. Account eligibility and actual GPU allocation remain unverified until the founder enables an accelerator and runs a GPU preflight.

decisions.decision: Reuse existing federated arXiv, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Europe PMC and OSTI metadata adapters on demand rather than duplicating public scientific databases.
decisions.reason: Founder clarifies that comprehensive research access must be preserved and expanded. Public APIs do not require reinstalling databases; standalone computational software may need isolated runtime installation. Free API availability, licensing and full-text rights vary.

decisions.decision: Treat Kaggle dual Tesla T4 GPUs as actually allocated, but do not claim Qwen3.6-27B has run.
decisions.reason: Founder-provided Kaggle nvidia-smi output (private screenshots, not republished) showed two Tesla T4s each 15,360 MiB, idle, CUDA driver 13.0 and running notebook session. Next check scratch disk and host RAM before any large public model download.

decisions.decision: Use the existing 25-source daily public world-horizon scanner as Prometheus Lab Radar, with an incremental source-linked archive.
decisions.reason: Actual first GitHub run #42405802931 produced records from 21 of 25 providers and 47 first-seen public links. A new-to-index link is not a confirmed breakthrough; data outages, archival quality and licenses remain visible. No duplicate source APIs or paid subscription.

decisions.decision: Integrate proven scientific packages into isolated execution workers rather than into every agent or the iPad.
decisions.reason: Real PySCF 2.15.0 H2 reference passed in independent CPU CI, joining previous OpenMM, PyBaMM and other bounded engines. This demonstrates scoped packages and mathematical outputs but not an autonomous scientific research service.

decisions.decision: Maintain a recurring global scientific research briefing separate from the underlying ingestion workflows.
decisions.reason: The owner-authorized daily briefing automation was successfully created for America/New_York mornings, using public source-linked GitHub archives and current primary sources. It does not run a permanent GPU, alter code or certify claimed breakthroughs.

decisions.decision: Require strict round-trip JSON validation and preserve provenance of any archived-research corrections.
decisions.reason: PR #56 fixed literal newline serialization errors exposed by a genuine live run; original faulty archive versions remain visible in Git history while corrected files parse reliably. Scientific evidence may never be silently rewritten.

decisions.decision: Use Kaggle only as a temporary first free model test; retain owner control of notebook and credentials.
decisions.reason: The current ChatGPT GitHub connector can change repository notebooks but lacks authenticated Kaggle read/write. Official Kaggle CLI can pull/push notebooks with Kaggle credential stored in approved secret storage, not in conversation or public GitHub. ChatGPT Plugin Directory search returned no matching Kaggle connector.

decisions.decision: Add geographically broad China laboratory and scientific literature signals without conflating public releases with verified discoveries.
decisions.reason: Chinese Academy of Sciences newsroom plus OpenAlex CN coauthor metadata are new read-only sources inside the same daily World Horizon source index. Tsinghua and further Chinese-language sources require separately reviewed translation, provenance and source coverage; no private Chinese institution access is implied.

decisions.decision: Keep Qwen3.6-27B as a strong affordable first test rather than asserting it is the best or AGI.
decisions.reason: Official Qwen research publishes competitive coding and STEM results; rankings depend on tasks and upstream benchmark methodology. Evaluate open-weight variants and possibly the 35B-A3B candidate on measured quality, latency, memory, cost, multimodal ability and held-out tasks before adoption.

decisions.decision: Preserve distinct verification of actual GPU access, scratch disk, notebook execution, model inference and durable autonomous AGI service.
decisions.reason: Screenshots verified two T4s and a live 14-minute notebook session, but /kaggle/temp was missing and no inference or persistence was established. Free Kaggle sessions and GitHub Actions are not always-on private AGI compute.

decisions.decision: Use the official Kaggle CLI through a manual GitHub workflow and protected Kaggle environment for account operations.
decisions.reason: Founder wants API read/write access. A private GitHub environment secret `KAGGLE_API_TOKEN` and initial owner run remain necessary; no token in chat or public files.

decisions.decision: Initial Kaggle write access must never automatically execute the expensive trial.
decisions.reason: Pinned upstream CLI --no-run Quick Save verified; restrict to a private Prometheus notebook and default model approval False. Broader edit/deletion needs review.

decisions.decision: Prioritize current Kaggle dual T4 for the first free model experiment; keep free Colab only as fallback.
decisions.reason: Founder GPU, scratch and RAM tests succeeded; Colab GPU supply and usage limits vary and neither provider guarantees persistent hosting.

decisions.decision: Treat Hugging Face ZeroGPU as an on-demand short demo option, not permanent compute.
decisions.reason: Current free-user ZeroGPU shared GPU quota is 5 minutes daily, despite larger 48/96GB GPU configurations. Production AGI requires separate durable compute and memory.

decisions.decision: Recognize Kaggle as authenticated through the owner's protected GitHub environment secret, not as directly connected to ChatGPT's Kaggle browser.
decisions.reason: Official GitHub workflow #42408852329 successfully used Kaggle CLI verify. Actual source read/write and model runs require separately authorized operations; no credentials must be disclosed in chat or public logs.

decisions.decision: Reuse Microsoft's official Playwright browser engine for a controlled first-phase Prometheus web capability.
decisions.reason: Official PyPI package 1.64.1 and Chromium did live public read-only and local click/type proof on CI #42409395480; plugin or agent-driven browser execution and authenticated sessions are still separate milestones.

decisions.decision: Protect Kaggle and other external-account environments with environment reviewers and branch restrictions, and rotate if token was exposed.
decisions.reason: Founder screenshot showed no required reviewers, administrator bypass enabled and deployment branches unrestricted. Public GitHub workflow code can be modified via merges, therefore secrets need strict owner approval and narrow workflows.

decisions.decision: Prefer public data APIs over web automation when official research services expose the information directly.
decisions.reason: Existing arXiv, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, CAS, NOAA, NASA etc. adapters provide source-linked records. Browser automation should fill website-only gaps, with explicit domain and action permissions, not duplicate bulk scholarly ingestion.

decisions.decision: Use one reviewed browser agent controller and require human confirmation for consequential website actions.
decisions.reason: Playwright Python worker is available; later Playwright MCP with existing LangGraph and a verified running model can plan/inspect. Never blindly let text on external sites trigger actions or grant financial, posting, private data and account mutation permissions.

decisions.decision: Separate ChatGPT browser plugin access from Prometheus independent browser execution.
decisions.reason: TinyFish browser automation app is eligible for connection in ordinary ChatGPT chats; user must explicitly install and authorize it. Independently, Plenum now has official Playwright MCP v0.0.84 and a fixed LangGraph read-only browser proof. Neither gives this chat direct authorization to the owner's browser or proves AGI.

decisions.decision: Use existing Playwright MCP and a fail-closed tool gateway rather than recreate an AI browser protocol.
decisions.reason: PR #62 verified official MCP stdio and public accessibility snapshot; PR #63 verified LangGraph end-to-end. Raw browser click/upload/evaluate tools must not be provided to untrusted model planners until a task policy, network sandbox, account scopes and approval gates exist.

decisions.decision: Prioritize genuine GPU model inference and held-out multi-step task evaluation over adding more redundant browser frameworks.
decisions.reason: Kaggle owner API authentication has succeeded, GPUs and free scratch were measured, but actual Qwen3.6-27B inference is not verified. Future model-directed browser tasks must be independently scored on unfamiliar scenarios and explicitly review account-affecting actions.

decisions.decision: Default to free-first public APIs, native ChatGPT web search and open-source browser tooling, and preserve TinyFish's promotional wallet for exceptional website automation.
decisions.reason: Source-backed current TinyFish Search/Fetch are free; Agent/Browser/Monitor/Deep Research are wallet-metered. Public-repo standard GitHub Actions runners are free and already run official Playwright/MCP for Plenum. Native ChatGPT search and Work within eligible plan limits can replace many costs, but free software does not imply free persistent GPUs or hosted model inference.

decisions.decision: Treat the Kaggle Qwen3.6-27B private trial notebook as uploaded, but not executed.
decisions.reason: The owner's second manual Kaggle bridge workflow #42413145594 was verified from actual job logs. The next gate remains explicit Kaggle-side free GPU opt-in and actual model report, with independent tests afterward.

decisions.decision: Reuse the existing LangGraph + Playwright MCP pipeline and Inspect AI rather than installing more browser agents or research evaluators.
decisions.reason: Official Microsoft MCP, isolated real Chromium, independent source-limited tool gateway and LangGraph evidence chain were already tested. Additional browser-use or hosted agent frameworks would duplicate these functions until a measured capability deficiency warrants change.

operating_rules: On every status/resume request, fetch the latest state and append-only evidence from research-memory before advising.
Label scheduled, implemented, experimentally confirmed, and failed work distinctly.
Never infer scientific novelty or general intelligence from generated language or green CI.
Do not auto-publish private content or authorize spending, model promotion, external communication, or unrestricted code execution.
Update this public-safe status after important verified experiments and decisions, preserving previous evidence URLs.
